submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires on the token that seals a locally complete 2-4 word chunk: either the complement that saturates a preceding determiner, preposition, verb or frequent collocation (the onions, at sea, stock market, are you going), or the boundary token right after a finished clause or noun phrase (after, before, for, sentence-final period over a comma). It is driven by the 1-2 preceding tokens, so the same word fires weakly or not at all when the chunk is still open, incomplete, or continues.
